text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Copano Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Over there! They've got the Paka Petit 
game!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Copano Rickey 
points, there's a claw crane game filled 
with plushies designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Paka Puchi are so cute~ If I had a lot of 
these, my little sisters might love them~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ever since coming to Tracen Academy, I 
haven't been able to spend much time with 
them, so I worry they might be feeling 
lonely, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'm gonna try this! I'll 
definitely get that present!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I-It's no good, I can't catch any at 
all~~... This is pretty hard, huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Guess I have no choice but to give up for 
today... If I study the tricks and try 
again later, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer, you're gonna win it for me!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you! I'd be so happy if you 
won a bunch for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
